Flick the striker from your baseline to knock coins into the corner pockets.

Slide the striker along your line, aim with the angle and power sliders or by dragging back from it like a slingshot, then flick. Pocket one of your own coins (white or black) to shoot again. A rival's coin that goes in still counts for them.

Pocket the queen and cover her with one of your own coins on the same flick or the next, or she goes back to the centre. A pocketed striker is a foul: a coin goes back. Clear your colour to win the board; you score a point for each coin your rivals have left, and three more with the queen.

Slide stones down the ice toward the house. After every stone is thrown, the team with the stone closest to the button scores a point for each of its stones that is closer than the rival's best.

Tap the ice where you want your stone to stop; the game sets the line and weight, which you can fine tune with the sliders. Turn the handle to curl left or right. Press Throw, then press Sweep while it slides: sweeping carries it further and keeps it straighter, or switch on automatic sweeping.

A stone must stop beyond the far hog line to stay in play, and one that touches the side lines or slides past the back line is out. The team that did not score gets the last stone, the hammer, next end.
